headline: Oarbreaker and Stlican See Action as Clahstra Clashes Escalate
war_summary: Territorial shifts have reignited across the flanks, marked by Warden forces seizing Fort Fogwood in Oarbreaker and securing fresh ground in Stlican Shelf at Fort Hoarfrost and The South Wind over the past two hours. In contrast, the rapid base exchanges that previously roiled Godcrofts, Farranac Coast, Fishermans Row, and the Dead Lands have paused, with no strategic assets changing hands during the latest watch. Violent combat has flared intensely in Clahstra, where casualty rates are accelerating rapidly and claimed over two thousand combined troops in the last two hours alone. Frontline attrition remains punishingly heavy along the central line, with Weathered Expanse, Dead Lands, Linn of Mercy, and Lykos Isle reporting continuous high casualty tallies despite slightly cooling momentum in overall troop enlistments.
